info.title: OpenAsy Threat Intel API
info.summary: Indicators from STIX, CSV and text feeds, one lookup for the other products, and an allow list with reasons.
info.description:
Every screen of threat-intel uses this API, and so can your scripts and the other OpenAsy products (ADR 0014). Within `/api/v1` changes are additive only; anything removed is deprecated first (ADR 0024). Errors use Problem Details (RFC 9457).

Feeds import with `THREAT_INTEL_INGEST_TOKEN`, which may also look values up. Everything else takes the session of a signed-in person or an API token, and each operation names the role it needs (`x-openasy-role`: viewer, editor, admin; ADR 0003). TLP:RED indicators are only for editors, admins and the ingest token; for anyone else they do not exist.

Sign-in, members and API tokens are under `/api/v1/auth`, provided by [@openasy/auth](https://github.com/openasy/auth#routes).

post.description:
Where indicators come from. A feed's defaults fill in what its indicators do not say.

Needs the admin role.

patch.description:
New defaults apply to indicators stored from now on.

Needs the admin role.

post.description:
Read by the feed's kind, optionally gzipped, up to 32 MiB and 200,000 indicators:

- `stix`: a STIX 2.1 bundle. Indicators with patterns of `=`, `IN` and `ISSUBSET` on addresses, domains, URLs, email addresses and file hashes, joined by OR. Confidence, validity, TLP markings, labels and revocation are kept. Anything else is named in `unparsed` with its reason.
- `csv`: a header row with `value` and optionally type, confidence, tlp, severity, tags, description, valid_from, valid_until, include_subdomains.
- `text`: one value per line; `#` starts a comment.

An indicator the feed already has is replaced, so a feed can be sent again whole. Nothing is stored when the import itself cannot be read.

```bash
curl -sf -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $THREAT_INTEL_INGEST_TOKEN" --data-binary @bundle.json \
  https://intel.example.com/api/v1/feeds/<id>/import
```

Takes THREAT_INTEL_INGEST_TOKEN, or an API token with the editor role.

schema.description: A STIX 2.1 bundle, for a stix feed.

200.description: What was stored, and what was left out and why.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: `inactive`: revoked, not yet valid or ended.

200.description: Most recently changed first. TLP:RED is left out for viewers.

post.description:
Into a manual feed. Imports go to the other kinds.

Needs the editor role.

201.description: Stored, or replaced when the feed had it.

get.description:
A TLP:RED indicator is not found for viewers.

Needs the viewer role.

delete.description:
A feed that sends it again stores it again; to keep a value from matching, put it on the allow list.

Needs the editor role.

get.description:
For the other products: is this address, domain, URL, email address or hash known to be bad? An address also matches the blocks that hold it, and a domain the parents that include subdomains. Only active indicators count.

Takes THREAT_INTEL_INGEST_TOKEN, or the session or API token of anyone with the viewer role. TLP:RED indicators count only for editors, admins and the ingest token.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Without it, the type the value looks like.

post.description:
Up to 1000 values in one call. One wrong item refuses the call, naming it.

Takes THREAT_INTEL_INGEST_TOKEN, or the session or API token of anyone with the viewer role. TLP:RED indicators count only for editors, admins and the ingest token.

200.description: One result per item, in order.

post.description:
A value known to be fine is `allowed` in every lookup, whatever matches, until the entry expires. A block allows every address in it.

Needs the editor role.

200.description: From OPENASY_PRODUCTS, for the product switcher.
Metrics in the Prometheus text format.

session.name: __Host-openasy-session
session.description: The browser session after signing in (`openasy-session` when threat-intel runs on plain http://localhost). Requests that change something must come from the threat-intel origin.

apiToken.description: An API token created under Settings → API tokens (`oa_threat-intel_...`): one role, always an expiry (ADR 0003).

adminToken.description: Only when threat-intel is started by its tests or a local script: one shared token with the admin role. A production install does not have it.

ingestToken.description: `THREAT_INTEL_INGEST_TOKEN`: for the jobs that import feeds and the products that look values up. It can do those two things, nothing else.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 Problem Details.

id.description: The product, as OpenAsy names it.

url.description: The address people open it at.

IndicatorType.description: What the value is. `cidr` is a block of addresses; looking up an address finds the blocks that hold it.

Tlp.description: Traffic Light Protocol 2.0. `red` is for named recipients: only editors, admins and the ingest token see it.

FeedKind.description: How the feed takes indicators: a STIX 2.1 bundle, a CSV, a list of values one per line, or one at a time.

Verdict.description: `malicious` when an active indicator with confidence 60 or more matches, `suspicious` below that, `allowed` when the allow list has it, whatever matched.

defaultTtlDays.description: How long an indicator stays active when it does not say.

received.description: Indicators, rows or lines in the import.

updated.description: Indicators the feed already had; their fields are replaced.

revoked.description: STIX indicators marked revoked: kept, and never matched.

skippedCount.description: Entries with a value or field that is wrong.

ref.description: The line, row or STIX id.

unparsedCount.description: STIX patterns that ask for something an indicator list cannot hold, such as AND or other objects.

value.description: In its stored form: refanged, lowercased, IPv6 compressed, host bits of a block cleared.

includeSubdomains.description: For a domain: its subdomains match too.

active.description: Not revoked, and now is between validFrom and validUntil.

feed.description: The id or name of a manual feed.

value.description: Defanged values are read too: hxxp://bad[.]example.

type.description: Without it, the type the value looks like.

NewIndicator.description: Fields left out take the feed's defaults.

via.description: How it matched: the value itself, a block that holds the address, or a parent domain that includes subdomains.

type.description: Without it, the type the value looks like. Not cidr: look up an address.

reason.description: Required: a decision without a reason is lost the day its author leaves.

allowListed.description: Allow-list entries that have not expired.
